title: "Custom Quarto Engine Demo"
format: html
engine: markdown
---

## Stateful session

Variables persist across cells. Define a variable:

```{term}
let name = world
let greeting = Hello, ${name}!
```

Use it in a later cell:

```{term}
print greeting
```

## Echo disabled

```{term}
#| echo: false
let secret = 42
print secret
```

## Custom option: reverse

```{term}
#| reverse: true
Hello from the reverse side!
```

## Custom option: prefix

```{term}
#| prefix: ">>> "
let x = 10
let y = ${x} squared
print y
```

## State carries through

The session remembers everything from earlier cells:

```{term}
print name
print greeting
print x
```
